name: tool-choice-without-tools-present
note: 6b36eb592: an explicitly requested tool_choice IS sent even when the request carries no tools. The commit reverts fe37e9f9b, whose `options?.toolChoice && params.tools?.length` guard this scenario used to pin in the opposite direction. Because fe37e9f9b landed and was reverted entirely after pi-ai 0.84.3 (release 4e58f324f), the published build never contained the guard and matches upstream HEAD again — so backend is back to "dist", the stronger reference. This is the no-tools arm.
